name: investment_npv_irr
title: Economic evaluation of an investment: net present value and internal rate of return
summary: Year-by-year cash-flow evaluation of an energy-saving investment over its lifetime: the PROCEDUREs NPV (escalated benefit/cost, tax, annuity, depreciation, discounting, lookup table output) and procIRR (cash flows re-discounted at the unknown rate) give the net present value, the discounted payback year and the internal rate of return solved from NPV_IRR = 0. No thermodynamics: meant to be fed with the cost and saving figures of an energy model.

origin.course: Machines et systèmes thermiques (ULiège), economic evaluation of energy-saving measures

verification.summary: Runnable variant vs the EES stored solution (compare_solution.py): 17 common variables, 0 differ at rtol=0.001; at rtol=1e-12 the largest printed residual is 4.54e-10 (k_IRR). The 461 EES-only values are procedure locals (CS-GAP-BODY-LOCALS-SOL) and stale/leftover records (CS-BUG-EXTRACT-STALE). The recomputed cash flows also match EES's own lookup table (0 differ at rtol=1e-9, max 8.06e-12).
verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (478 variables, the last EES calculation) and the lookup table 'data' hand-decoded from the same file (44x14 columns, rows 1-11 the default run); the parametric table1 (12502x2) is a phantom decode (CS-BUG-EXTRACT-TABLE-FP) and was not used.
verification.notes: Concerns the runnable variant investment_npv_irr_coolsolve.eescode: 17 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); at rtol=1e-12 the printed residuals are annuite 1.82e-10, k_IRR 4.54e-10, NPV 2.28e-11 (rounding of the stored 9-10 digit values). The 461 EES-only values are the locals of the two PROCEDUREs (341, absent from every .sol: CS-GAP-BODY-LOCALS-SOL) and leftovers of an earlier version of the file (120: a[], annuite[], D, D[], PBT, R[], TIR, YEAR, j); the stored locals are stale (B[2] = 6270 = 6000*1.045, the earlier parameter set of TM-0269, vs 40 from the current equations: CS-BUG-EXTRACT-STALE). A scratch run of the native file with only the 14 write lines removed reads EES's own table and agrees with the variant on all 17 variables (0 differ at rtol=1e-9, max 8.06e-12 on k_IRR); an independent Python hand calculation gives annuite 10.000550008180202, NPV 8.140371574323868, IRR 0.12414075355640218, DDP 10. Unit system of the source: SI MASS DEG PA C J (no conversion). The stats are those of the variant; the native file does not parse.
